statement: A South Korea-backed gas project at Encinal, South Texas would add up to 6.3 GW of generation aimed at AI data centers, starting with a 1.4 GW first phase.
why: Dedicated multi-gigawatt generation earmarked for AI data centers relieves the power bottleneck that currently gates GPU-cluster deployment in Texas.

impact.mechanism: New gas-turbine and combined-cycle capacity reserved for AI data centers expands the power envelope available for GPU deployments, easing a binding non-chip constraint on cluster build-out.

evidence.excerpt: Project capacity: an initial phase of '1.4 gigawatts of gas-turbine generation,' with a potential expansion of '4.9 additional gigawatts of combined-cycle capacity,' for a stated total potential of '6.3 gigawatts.'

confidence.basis: Single secondary outlet; the capacity figures describe a planned project that the Korean Industry Ministry says is not final, not commissioned capacity.

dispersion: conflicting same-key reports: magnitude 1 -> 2; sources: Dallas Express
